name: Calm Pages
body:
Calm Pages

School abjuration [air]; Level alchemist 1, magus 0, wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one book touched
Duration 1 minute/level
Saving Throw none (harmless, object); Spell Resistance no (harmless, object)

While affected by calm pages, a book or document isn’t affected by winds or air currents, and windy conditions don’t impose any penalties to reading or using such written materials. Documents protected by this spell aren’t at risk of being blown away by the wind.

If cast underwater, it provides the same protection against water currents; however, the paper must be waterproofed by other means.
